title: Idempotent: new Date() in render is a bug

slides.say: A Rule of React: components must be idempotent. Same props, state and context, same output, every time.
New Date returns something different every time it is called. So this component is not idempotent. And the time just stays stuck at the moment it rendered.

slides.text: Same for Math.random(). Fine to use, just not during render.
slides.say: Math random is the same story. You can still use these functions. Just not during render.
The docs move the changing value out of rendering. An Effect sets the new date every second, so render only reads state.
